# Fixtures

`example_mod.wasm`: the release build of
[stormlight-example-mod](https://github.com/AestroFidelium/stormlight-example-mod)
(MIT OR Apache-2.0), built against stormlight-sdk `d6440ec`. A real mod the game loads:
the validator must accept it. Rebuild with `cargo build --release --target
wasm32-unknown-unknown` in that repository and copy the `.wasm` here.
